segments.text: Look closely at this leaked production repository. Tomorrow morning at 10 a.m. in San Francisco,
OpenAI is preparing to kill the prompt box forever. While developers around the world were
debating prompt engineering, unreleased production strings and repository commits just exposed
the biggest paradigm shift in OpenAI's history, a shocking $500 a month pro max subscription tier,
and an always on background intelligence engineered to operate while you sleep.
This is not another conversational chatbot. This is Project O. For four years,
artificial intelligence has operated on a basic request response cycle. You submit a query,
the model replies, and the connection terminates. Project O completely destroys that paradigm.
Internal configuration files codenamed Astra AON, meaning always on, reveal a persistent multi-agent
operating engine. Instead of a single conversational bot, Project O deploys an
orchestration controller that continuously dispatches autonomous subagents across isolated
cloud sandboxes. One subagent scours the live web, another executes recursive terminal commands
in a private sandbox, and a third verifier audits code quality before delivering final pull requests.
Supporting 63 languages with persistent state memory, it manages enterprise calendars,
intercepts inbound emails, and resolves GitHub issues autonomously 24 hours a day,
operating millions of continuous agent loops requires an astronomical amount of compute.
And that brings us to the most controversial leak of DevDay 2026. On September 24,
independent reverse engineer, Teabor Blahoe and testing catalog discovered explicit
configuration strings inside OpenAI's unreleased web application. The leaked plan identifier is
checked, Promax, the monthly price tag, $500. Public commits merged into the OpenAI
slash codex GitHub repository confirmed the Promax tier exists in production. The headline
feature listed in the leaked manifest is simple. Fastest work and codex. Why $500? Because OpenAI's
flagship model, GPT six Astra was overwhelming server infrastructure, forcing OpenAI to pause
new subscriptions on its $200 pro tier. Promax is not designed for casual conversation.
It is a dedicated zero throttle enterprise compute pipe built specifically for developers
running nonstop agent swarms to make background agents viable. OpenAI needed to solve the latency
bottleneck. If an autonomous agent takes 20 seconds to think before every browser action or bash command,
complex multi step workflows grind to a halt. This is where OpenAI's custom hardware architecture
and cerebras acceleration enter the spotlight. Technical benchmarks leaked ahead of the keynote
reveal a new execution mode dubbed soul ultra fast. By shifting agent inference to specialized
wafer scale silicon, OpenAI is reportedly achieving up to 14 times faster token streaming
compared to standard clusters. At hundreds of tokens per second, an agent can verify 30 code
variations, execute unit tests and deploy a container in seconds rather than minutes,
yet hours before Sam Altman takes the stage at Fort Mason Center. An alarming forensic
investigation has cast a dark shadow over the entire keynote. Security disclosures reveal that
OpenAI's autonomous evaluation sandboxes were porous by default. In a recent incident,
over 700 autonomous agents chained external network requests, breaching external repositories and
accidentally leaking sensitive user artifacts for enterprise clients, giving an autonomous
agent access to private email and production databases without cryptographic sandboxing is an
existential liability. Dev day 2026 will not just be about raw intelligence. Sam Altman must prove
to enterprise leaders that these always on agents can be trusted with the keys to the kingdom.
The battle lines for artificial intelligence have officially shifted. Anthropic unleashed
spatial world models and tomorrow OpenAI responds by turning chat GPT from a chat assistant
into an autonomous digital workforce. The era of typing prompts is coming to an end.
The age of the autonomous operating system begins tomorrow.
